instruction:
Migrate Legacy Office Model To IFC4

This task starts from /home/user/Desktop/init.ifc and may use /home/user/Desktop/init_plan.png as a local reference image. Migrate the provided legacy office IFC to IFC4 and save the required output as /home/user/Desktop/result.ifc.

## Pass conditions
1. The output folder contains /home/user/Desktop/result.ifc, and /home/user/Desktop/result.ifc is at least 500 bytes.
2. /home/user/Desktop/result.ifc uses an IFC4 schema.
3. The IFC model contains exactly 1 IfcProject, 1 IfcSite, 1 IfcBuilding, 2 IfcBuildingStorey entities, 2 IfcSpace entities, 8 IfcWall entities, 2 IfcSlab entities, 1 IfcRoof, and 1 IfcWallType.
4. The IFC model contains 0 IfcDoor, 0 IfcWindow, 0 IfcBuildingElementProxy, 0 IfcFurniture, 0 IfcColumn, 0 IfcBeam, 0 IfcStair, and 0 IfcFlowTerminal entities.
5. All IfcRoot GlobalId values are unique.
6. The single IfcProject is named exactly Normalized IFC4, the single IfcSite is named exactly Default Site, the single IfcBuilding is named exactly Default Building, the IfcBuildingStorey names are exactly Ground Floor and Upper Floor, and the single IfcWallType is named exactly ExtWallType-A, each ignoring leading and trailing whitespace only.
7. The IfcSpace names are exactly GF Office and UF Office, ignoring leading and trailing whitespace only, and each has bounding-box dimensions 9.40 m by 7.40 m by 2.80 m, in any axis order, with tolerance +/-0.08 m.
8. The wall names are exactly W-S, W-S-UP, W-N, W-N-UP, W-W, W-W-UP, W-E, and W-E-UP, ignoring leading and trailing whitespace only. W-S, W-S-UP, W-N, and W-N-UP each have bounding-box dimensions 10.00 m by 0.20 m by 3.00 m, and W-W, W-W-UP, W-E, and W-E-UP each have 0.20 m by 8.00 m by 3.00 m, each in any axis order with tolerance +/-0.08 m.
9. The slab names are exactly GF Slab and UF Slab, ignoring leading and trailing whitespace only, and each has bounding-box dimensions 10.00 m by 8.00 m by 0.20 m, in any axis order, with tolerance +/-0.08 m.
10. The roof is named exactly Roof, ignoring leading and trailing whitespace only, and has bounding-box dimensions 10.00 m by 8.00 m by 0.25 m, in any axis order, with tolerance +/-0.08 m.
11. All spaces, walls, slabs, and the roof are spatially assigned to either Ground Floor or Upper Floor.

Any item not explicitly required in the pass conditions may vary.
